message: Desk and document models, four desk facings, the production passport/issuance screens, and native station controls passed.
interfaceData: Explicit sample identity/profile in the actual production IdentityScreen; not a live Chronicles runtime profile
signatureData: Sample ink1 monochrome drawing, decoded by the production domain decoder and rendered by the production UI
interfaceChecks: Native issue, reissue and 100-tick refresh send empty payloads; server eligibility controls button availability; no editable character fields.

Read-only issued snapshots retain fields across current/outdated/offline/unavailable statuses, hide fields when invalid, and have no station refresh or mutation controls. Standalone and malformed drawings render absent.
Controls fit a 320x240 viewport. Empty/invalid physical sessions close only the identity menu, preserving unrelated screens.
